title: Resume browser filter chips — contract — acceptance

steps.path: Open a past conversation → the search box and the row of chips under it
steps.headline: The contract, graded — accept these verdicts?

rows.statement: The three chips match the app's other filter chips in size and shape, with a chevron that points up while a menu is open.
rows.evidence: approved docs/active/design/2026-09-10-resume-filter-chips/images/resume-filter-chips.review/chips--light--after.png + --midnight; built scratch/grader/crops/R1-chips--light.png + --midnight (resume-filters/resume-browser 470x50+485+288), stacked in scratch/grader/cmp/R1-chips--*.png. Same chip size, pill shape, 14 px text and chevron in both themes; the only difference is the sort glyph (round-1 arrow vs the sort bars approved in round 2, C-1).

rows.statement: The Projects menu shows square check boxes, a count on each row, and a Clear button pinned at the bottom.
rows.evidence: approved docs/active/design/2026-09-10-resume-filter-chips/images/resume-filter-chips.review/projects-menu--light--after.png + --midnight; built scratch/grader/crops/R2-projects-menu--light.png + --midnight (resume-projects-open 640x180+400+288), stacked in scratch/grader/cmp/R2-projects-menu--*.png. Square boxes, counts 1/2/1 at the right edge, Clear pinned in the footer, chevron pointing up while open — identical in both themes.

rows.statement: The Tags menu opens straight onto your tags, each with its count, and Clear sits at the bottom.
rows.evidence: approved docs/active/design/2026-09-10-resume-filter-chips/images/resume-filter-chips.review/tags-menu--light--after.png + --midnight; built scratch/grader/crops/R3-tags-menu--light.png + --midnight (resume-tags-open 640x190+400+288), stacked in scratch/grader/cmp/R3-tags-menu--*.png. Opens straight onto work/bug/idea with a count each and Clear at the bottom; Manage tags… is absent, as the row note asks (the approved picture still shows it; round 2 S-10 removed it).

rows.statement: A chip names the one tag or project you picked; two or more show as a count, like Tags 2.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/filter-menu-chip.test.tsx — Tests 9 passed (9). Read: 'chip labels (pickLabel — contract R4)' asserts one pick → its name, two → {text:'Tags', count:2}, four → count 4, and that ResumeBrowser renders pickLabel('Projects'/'Tags') with no comma-joined names or 'Projects (N)'.

rows.statement: On a wide window the three chips stay as a full row; only a phone-width window folds them into the filter button.
rows.note: could we collapse into the expandable filter menu button thing used in the project view and session file view things? only on mobile/narrow, leave as full chips on desktop/wide

rows.statement: The sort chip flips the order with one tap; it does not open a menu.
This screen keeps saying sessions: Resume Session, Search sessions, No matching sessions, and the reopen button stays Resume Session.
The dialog keeps shrinking to fit a short list when you filter; it is not held at one fixed height.
The sort chip carries the sort bars, three bars with a down arrow, and lights up while the order is oldest first.
rows.evidence: approved docs/active/design/2026-09-10-resume-filter-chips/images/resume-filter-chips.review-2/sort-b--light--after.png (C-1 'bars'); built scratch/grader/crops/R9-sort-b--light.png (resume-browser over resume-sort-flipped, each 470x50+485+288), stacked in scratch/grader/cmp/R9-sort-b--light.png. At rest: Most recent with three bars wide-to-narrow and a down arrow, unlit; after one tap: Oldest first, lit, bars narrow-to-wide. Matches.

rows.statement: Below 640 px the chips row is gone; the search pill holds the filter button, with a count badge when a filter is on.
rows.evidence: approved docs/active/design/2026-09-10-resume-filter-chips/images/resume-filter-chips.review-2/narrow-row--light--after.png + --midnight; built scratch/grader/crops/R10b-narrow-row--light.png + --midnight (re-taken on ecef481c: resume-filters-narrow/resume-browser 390x150+0+90), side by side in scratch/grader/cmp/R10b-narrow-row--*.png — identical. Full shot scratch/grader/narrow-2/light/resume-browser.png: no chips row, the search pill with the filter button docked at its right end; scratch/grader/narrow-2/light/resume-filters-picked.png shows the count badge (1) on that button once a project is ticked.

rows.statement: Manage tags… is gone from the Tags menu; Clear stands alone in its footer, like the Projects menu.
rows.evidence: approved docs/active/design/2026-09-10-resume-filter-chips/images/resume-filter-chips.review-2/tags-menu-2--light--after.png + --midnight; built scratch/grader/crops/R11-tags-menu-2--light.png + --midnight (resume-tags-open 640x190+400+288), stacked in scratch/grader/cmp/R11-tags-menu-2--*.png. Footer holds Clear alone, centred, same as the Projects menu; no Manage tags….

rows.statement: The phone filter panel holds the desktop chips: Projects and Tags dropdowns and the Most recent sort chip, with Clear at the top.
rows.evidence: approved docs/active/design/2026-09-10-resume-filter-chips/images/resume-filter-chips.review-3/narrow-open--light--after.png + --midnight; built scratch/grader/crops/R12-narrow-open--light.png + --midnight (re-taken on ecef481c: resume-filters-narrow/resume-filters-open 390x330+0+90), side by side in scratch/grader/cmp/R12-narrow-open--*.png. The panel opens without the earlier crash and holds Filters, the Projects and Tags dropdown chips and the Most recent sort chip wrapped to a second line, same as approved in both themes; Clear appears at the top right once something is picked (scratch/grader/narrow-2/light/resume-filters-picked.png), which the approved at-rest picture does not show either. First run (0305f346) failed: tapping the filter button crashed to 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (scratch/grader/narrow/light/_unverified/resume-filters-open.png); fixed by ecef481c.

rows.statement: A dropdown opened inside the phone panel is the desktop menu; picking rows keeps both open, and a tap outside closes them together.
After one tap the sort bars turn narrow-to-wide for oldest first, and nothing else on the row changes.
rows.evidence: approved docs/active/design/2026-09-10-resume-filter-chips/images/resume-filter-chips.review-3/sort-bars--light--after.png + --midnight; built scratch/grader/crops/R14-sort-bars--light.png + --midnight (resume-sort-flipped 470x50+485+288), stacked in scratch/grader/cmp/R14-sort-bars--*.png. Oldest first lit with narrow-to-wide bars; Projects and Tags unchanged beside it. Identical in both themes.

rows.statement: Dragging the window wider than a phone while the filter panel is open leaves Projects and Tags opening their menus as before.
With nothing picked a chip says Projects or Tags; one pick shows its name; more show the category and a count.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/filter-menu-chip.test.tsx — Tests 9 passed (9). Read: pickLabel('Projects', []) → {text:'Projects'}; one name → that name; several → category + count; plus the source check that ResumeBrowser renders both chips through pickLabel.

rows.statement: The developer note on the menu check box describes the rows as they are built, not a different pattern.
The developer note above the search box describes the two-width layout that is actually there.
The developer note on the tag manager no longer claims the Tags filter menu opens it.
The chips' chevron is the one shared glyph the dropdown fields and the find bar draw, not a private copy.
A tap outside an open menu closes only that menu; the list stays open and your filters stay set.
At phone width, when ticking a row shrinks the list, the open menu moves with its chip instead of floating loose.
On desktop a long picked name is cut short so all three chips still fit on the row.
